pairs: In the third year of Cyrus, king of the Persians,
verbum revelatum est Danieli cognomento Baltassar,
a message was revealed to Daniel, called Belteshazzar,
intelligentia enim est opus in visione.
for understanding is needed in a vision.
In diebus illis ego Daniel lugebam trium hebdomadarum diebus:
In those days, I, Daniel, mourned for three weeks of days.
et vinum non introierunt in os meum,
neither was I anointed with ointment,
until the three weeks of days were completed.
Die autem vigesima et quarta mensis primi,
But on the twenty-fourth day of the first month,
I was next to the great river,
And I lifted up my eyes,
et ecce vir unus vestitus lineis,
and behold, one man clothed in linen,
et renes ejus accincti auro obrizo:
and his waist was wrapped with the finest gold,
and his body was like the golden stone,
et facies ejus velut species fulguris,
and his face had the appearance of lightning,
et oculi ejus ut lampas ardens:
and his eyes that of a burning lamp,
et brachia ejus, et quæ deorsum sunt usque ad pedes, quasi species æris candentis:
and his arms and all that is downward all the way to the feet had the appearance of glowing brass,
et vox sermonum ejus ut vox multitudinis.
and his speaking voice was like the voice of a multitude.
Vidi autem ego Daniel solus visionem:
But I, Daniel, alone saw the vision,
porro viri qui erant mecum non viderunt,
for the men who were with me did not see it,
sed terror nimius irruit super eos,
but an exceedingly great terror rushed over them,
Ego autem relictus solus vidi visionem grandem hanc:
And I, having been left alone, saw this great vision,
et non remansit in me fortitudo,
and there remained no strength in me,
sed et species mea immutata est in me,
et emarcui, nec habui quidquam virium.
and I languished, not having any strength.
And I heard the voice of his words,
et audiens jacebam consternatus super faciem meam,
and when I heard, I lay down in confusion on my face,
and my face was close to the ground.
et erexit me super genua mea,
and raised me onto my knees and the knuckles of my hands.
intellige verba quæ ego loquor ad te,
understand the words that I speak to you,
nunc enim sum missus ad te.
for I am now sent to you.”
And when he had said these words to me,
because from the first day that you set your heart to understand,
quo posuisti cor tuum ad intelligendum ut te affligeres in conspectu Dei tui,
by afflicting yourself in the sight of your God,
et ego veni propter sermones tuos.
and I have arrived because of your words.
Princeps autem regni Persarum restitit mihi viginti
But the leader of the kingdom of the Persians resisted me for twenty-one days,
et ego remansi ibi juxta regem Persarum.
and I remained there next to the king of the Persians.
Veni autem ut docerem te quæ ventura sunt populo tuo in novissimis diebus,
But I have come to teach you what will happen to your people in the latter days,
because the vision is for a long time from now.”
And while he was speaking words to me in this way,
I cast my face down to the ground
Et ecce quasi similitudo filii hominis tetigit labia mea:
And behold, something in the likeness of a son of man touched my lips.
et aperiens os meum locutus sum,
et dixi ad eum, qui stabat contra me:
I spoke and said to him who stood before me,
in visione tua dissolutæ sunt compages meæ, et nihil in me remansit virium.
at the sight of you, my limbs became weak and no strength has remained in me.
Et quomodo poterit servus domini mei loqui cum domino meo?
nihil enim in me remansit virium,
how can the servant of my lord speak with my lord?
For no strength remains in me;
and even my breathing is hindered.”
Rursum ergo tetigit me quasi visio hominis,
Therefore, he who looked like a man,
touched me again and strengthened me.
And when he spoke to me,
Numquid scis quare venerim ad te?
“Do you not know why I have come to you?
et nunc revertar ut prælier adversum principem Persarum.
And next I will return, to fight against the leader of the Persians.
there appeared the leader of the Greeks arriving.
Verumtamen annuntiabo tibi quod expressum est in scriptura veritatis:
But, in truth, I announce to you what is expressed in the scripture of truth.
et nemo est adjutor meus in omnibus his,
And no one is my helper in all these things,
